staged_cases.population: 563 ES-SCLC patients without progression after first-line durvalumab plus platinum–etoposide induction; n=282 vs 281
staged_cases.intervention: Tarlatamab 10 mg IV every 2 weeks with protocol step-up dosing plus durvalumab 1,500 mg IV every 4 weeks
staged_cases.follow_up: Median OS follow-up 15.9 vs 16.1 months; PFS follow-up 13.9 months
staged_cases.efficacy: Median OS 21.1 vs 12.7 months; HR 0.42 (95% CI 0.32–0.54), P<0.001. Median PFS 7.4 vs 1.9 months; HR 0.34 (95% CI 0.28–0.42), P<0.001. 12-month OS 79.4% vs 53.3%; ORR 26.4% vs 4.1% among measurable disease n=235 vs244.
staged_cases.toxicity: Grade ≥3 TEAEs 46.8% vs40.6%; CRS 49.6% vs1.4%, grade 3 CRS 0.4%; ICANS about1.1%.
staged_cases.quality_of_life: Not reported in primary interim paper.
staged_cases.nnt_nnh: NNT 4 at 12 months for OS from Kaplan–Meier rates: ceil[100/(79.4−53.3)]=4. NNH not calculated because cumulative AEs lack a common fixed time horizon.

staged_cases.phase_design: Phase III, China-based, double-blind placebo-controlled randomized 1:1
staged_cases.population: 322 EGFR-variant non-squamous locally advanced/metastatic NSCLC patients after EGFR-TKI progression; 161 per arm
staged_cases.intervention: Ivonescimab 20 mg/kg IV every 3 weeks plus pemetrexed 500 mg/m² and carboplatin AUC5 every 3 weeks for 4 cycles, then ivonescimab plus pemetrexed maintenance
staged_cases.comparator: Placebo plus the same platinum–pemetrexed chemotherapy and maintenance
staged_cases.primary_endpoint: PFS by independent radiology review; OS key secondary
staged_cases.follow_up: Final OS analysis median follow-up 32.5 months
staged_cases.efficacy: Primary PFS 7.1 vs4.8 months (median follow-up 7.89 months; OS immature at the primary analysis); HR 0.46 (95% CI 0.34–0.62), P<0.001. ORR 50.6% vs35.4%, P=.006. Final OS 16.8 vs14.1 months; HR 0.74 (95% CI 0.58–0.95), P=.02. 30-month OS 29.1% vs18.4%.
staged_cases.toxicity: Final grade ≥3 TEAEs 67.1% vs54.7%; primary report grade ≥3 immune-related events 6.2% vs2.5% and VEGF-related events 3.1% vs2.5%.
staged_cases.quality_of_life: Not reported in accessible primary reports; supplement extraction pending.
staged_cases.nnt_nnh: NNT 10 at 30 months for OS: ceil[100/(29.1−18.4)]=10. NNH not calculated from cumulative AE rates without a common fixed-time exposure.
